_note: SYNTHETIC demonstration data written for the Sprint 2 demo. Not collected from students. Used only by seed_sprint2_synthetic_public.py on a local SQLite database to exercise the public feed, status history, reopen and resolution metrics.

complaints.title: Wi-Fi drops in hostel rooms every evening
complaints.description: The hostel Wi-Fi disconnects every few minutes between 8 pm and midnight, which makes online submissions difficult.

complaints.title: Water cooler on the ground floor is leaking
complaints.description: The water cooler near the stairs on the ground floor leaks continuously and the floor around it stays wet.

complaints.title: Corridor lights flicker at night
complaints.description: Most corridor tube lights on the second floor flicker after 10 pm, and two of them stay off.

complaints.title: Cafeteria water dispenser is empty at lunch
complaints.description: The drinking water dispenser in the cafeteria is usually empty between 1 pm and 2 pm on weekdays.

events.remark: Refill added to the lunch schedule

complaints.title: Several reading hall chairs are broken
complaints.description: At least five chairs in the main reading hall have loose legs or broken backrests.

complaints.title: Gym treadmill belt slips while running
complaints.description: The belt on one of the treadmills slips at higher speeds, which is unsafe for users.

complaints.title: Washroom drain is blocked
complaints.description: The floor drain in the first floor washroom is blocked and water collects near the showers.

complaints.title: Window latch in room does not close
complaints.description: The window latch does not lock, so the window opens with the wind and rain comes inside.
